question: The 2027 Tour de France route, unveiled this week, starts in Edinburgh. Modern Tours cover about 3,400 km. How long was the longest Tour ever, back in 1926?
question_short: Modern Tours de France cover about 3,400 km. How long was the longest ever, in 1926?
answer_detail: The 1926 Tour ran 17 brutal stages. Only 41 of 126 starters reached Paris, and winner Lucien Buysse spent over 238 hours in the saddle.
answer_short: Just 41 of 126 starters finished; winner Lucien Buysse rode over 238 hours.
